Traffic Advisory 

Due to road modification work at the Soorghat Integration Section under the Wazirabad Flyover (Burari–Timarpur Red Light carriageway) from 03.12.2025 to 25.12.2025, the affected stretch will remain closed for all traffic.

📍 DIVERSION ROUTES:
Traffic from Burari → Sonia Vihar / Bhajanpura / Khajuri:
Wazirabad Bridge → Right to Ambedkar Chowk → Right to Wazirabad Road → Left towards destination.

Traffic from Burari → Timarpur Red Light:
Wazirabad Bridge → Right to Ambedkar Chowk → Right to Wazirabad Road → Right towards Timarpur.

📍 ADVISORY FOR COMMUTERS:
Plan your travel accordingly, expect delays, and follow diversion signage. Traffic personnel are deployed to assist. Allow extra travel time to avoid inconvenience.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
